EmailTemplate.description: Email to promote Sept 1-15, 2024 Donor Offer
EmailTemplate.name: Seasonal_CriticalDay_RaglanTshirt_DonorOffer_Sept. 1-15,2024
EmailTemplate.subject: Exciting Offer for your Donors this September!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
Your blood drive is coming up, and every donation is vital because hospital patients are counting on lifesaving blood products from your drive. We are grateful for your kindness and commitment to helping those in need.
As autumn sets in, it's the perfect time to host a drive and encourage friends, family and co-workers to give blood and be a part of something bigger than themselves.
When donors come to give blood Sept. 1-15, 2024, they’ll receive an exclusive limited edition American Red Cross Raglan T-shirt.*
As you continue the work to make your drive a success – remember to use these tips:
Fill your schedule. Use these tools to recruit blood donors and schedule them using the Blood Drive Management Portal. Encourage donors to schedule a donation for a friend. Each additional donor scheduled means more lives saved!
If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to reach out – I’m always here to help!
IMPORTANT: Donors MUST have a valid email address on file to receive their reward.
All the best,
{!Lead.OwnerFirstName}
*Offer applicable to presenting donors only during the following dates above and while supplies last. T-shirt sizes are limited. Offer subject to availability of donation opportunities in presenting donor’s area. No substitutions and not transferable by presenting donor. Not redeemable for cash.
